name: ShopCardHub price indices
terms: Free to quote with a link to the index page the number came from.

definitions.generated: Date of the newest mark in this file. The file is rebuilt after each re-mark.
definitions.level: Index level on markDate. 100 = the index at its base month (baseDate, YYYY-MM).
definitions.basis: Every level is built from dated sold prices of raw (ungraded) cards. No listing prices.
definitions.change1w: Latest mark vs the latest earlier mark at least 5 days before it, in percent; from = that mark date.
definitions.change1m: Latest mark vs the latest earlier mark 27 to 41 days before it, in percent; null if the record is shorter.
definitions.change3m: Latest mark vs the latest earlier mark 85 to 135 days before it, in percent; null if the record is shorter.
definitions.top: Up to five highest-priced cards at the mark, each with its own dated sold mark in USD; sales30d = sales in the last 30 days where known.
